lead.headline: Ex-IAF chief calls HAL's rejection of indigenous radar a 'bad decision'
signal: Choices like this decide whether indigenous components get production volume.
lead.hook: Former Air Chief Marshal Bhadauria says HAL erred by buying more Israeli EL/M-2052 radars for the Tejas Mk1A instead of DRDO's Uttam radar.
points: He says flight-test data shows Uttam gives more range than the radar being integrated, and is ready for induction.
He suggests HAL chose foreign hardware as it is easier to certify and HAL already co-produces the Israeli radar.
Mk2 delay is partly due to undercarriage problems; he says HAL project management has been 'disastrous' and defence PSUs spend too little on R&D.
HAL's AMCA bid failed because one partner missed technical criteria; private bids are now submitted.
lead.evidence_of: India is shifting defence development toward private industry

stories.headline: PhysicsWallah cuts staff citing AI and earmarks under ==$20M for M==&A
signal: A listed Indian startup is openly linking AI to a smaller workforce.
stories.hook: PhysicsWallah's headcount, about 19,100, fell sequentially in Q2 FY27, partly due to AI efficiencies, and management says AI writes about 90% of its code.
points: Employee expenses fell 2.3% year-on-year excluding ESOP costs.
Q2 revenue was ₹1,242 crore (up 18%) and net profit ₹142 crore, up from ₹70 crore.
The offline business lost ₹108 crore at EBITDA level in H1 FY27, versus ₹120 crore a year earlier; it runs 370 centres, including 167 Vidyapeeth.
It is in advanced talks with a couple of online education firms, with under $20M earmarked; M&A __will add under 5% to FY27 growth__.
stories.evidence_of: AI lets firms grow revenue with fewer hires

patterns.name: AI lets firms grow revenue with fewer hires
patterns.line: Indian IT revenue grows 6.1% against 2.3% headcount growth, PhysicsWallah cut staff citing AI, and 52% of Indian CEOs plan some cuts. Entry-level roles are hit first.

evidence.title: PhysicsWallah cites AI efficiencies for job cuts; offline biz faces profit pressure, earmarks $20 Mn for M&A
